options.name: acceleration_pool_id
options.description: Acceleration Pool ID. Used while adding an acceleration device. Media type supported are C(SSD) and C(NVDIMM). Mutually exclusive with I(acceleration_pool_name), I(storage_pool_name) and I(storage_pool_id).

options.name: acceleration_pool_name
options.description: Acceleration Pool Name. Used while adding an acceleration device. Media type supported are C(SSD) and C(NVDIMM). Mutually exclusive with I(storage_pool_id), I(storage_pool_name) and I(acceleration_pool_name).

options.name: current_pathname
options.description: Full path of the device to be added. Required while adding a device.

options.name: device_id
options.description: Device ID. Mutually exclusive with I(device_name).

options.name: device_name
options.description: Device name. Mutually exclusive with I(device_id).

options.name: external_acceleration_type
options.description: Device external acceleration types. Used while adding a device.

options.name: force
options.description: Using the Force flag to add a device. Use this flag, to overwrite existing data on the device. Use this flag with caution, because all data on the device will be destroyed.

options.name: hostname
options.description: IP or FQDN of the PowerFlex host.

options.name: media_type
options.description: Device media types. Required while adding a device.

options.name: password
options.description: The password of the PowerFlex host.

options.name: port
options.description: Port number through which communication happens with PowerFlex host.

options.name: protection_domain_id
options.description: Protection domain ID. Used while identifying a storage pool along with I(storage_pool_name). Mutually exclusive with I(protection_domain_name).

options.name: protection_domain_name
options.description: Protection domain name. Used while identifying a storage pool along with I(storage_pool_name). Mutually exclusive with I(protection_domain_id).

options.name: sds_id
options.description: The ID of the SDS. Required while adding a device. Mutually exclusive with I(sds_name).

options.name: sds_name
options.description: The name of the SDS. Required while adding a device. Mutually exclusive with I(sds_id).

options.name: state
options.description: State of the device.

options.name: storage_pool_id
options.description: Storage Pool ID. Used while adding a storage device. Media type supported are C(SSD) and C(HDD). Mutually exclusive with I(storage_pool_name), I(acceleration_pool_id) and I(acceleration_pool_name).

options.name: storage_pool_name
options.description: Storage Pool name. Used while adding a storage device. Mutually exclusive with I(storage_pool_id), I(acceleration_pool_id) and I(acceleration_pool_name).

options.name: timeout
options.description: Time after which connection will get terminated. It is to be mentioned in seconds.

options.name: username
options.description: The username of the PowerFlex host.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: Boolean variable to specify whether or not to validate SSL certificate. C(true) - Indicates that the SSL certificate should be verified. C(false) - Indicates that the SSL certificate should not be verified.
